markup.[[x]]: 重点形式：这个语法要你注意的词（橙底）
markup.{x}: 变化的部分：只用在 [[ ]] 里，例如 work{s}（橙底里加粗下划线）
markup.((x)): 变回原形的动词（虚线下划线）
markup.~~x~~: 错句里错的部分（删除线）

idea.title: 一句话说清
idea.text: 条件句就是「**如果……就……**」。按这件事**有多大可能**分三种：每次都这样（零）、真有可能发生（第一）、只是假设、不太可能（第二）。

uses.en_zh: 要是下雨，我们就待在家里。

uses.en: If I [[had]] more time, I[['d learn]] Japanese.
uses.en_zh: 要是我有更多时间，我就学日语。

zero.title: 零条件句：每次都这样
zero.rule: 说规律、事实、每次都会发生的事。两半都用一般现在时。这里的 if 几乎等于 when（每当）。

examples.en: If you [[press]] this button, the app [[restart{s}]].
examples.zh: 按这个按钮，App 就会重启。

examples.en: If I [[drink]] coffee after four, I [[can't]] sleep.
examples.zh: 我四点以后喝咖啡就睡不着。

first.title: 第一条件句：真有可能
first.rule: 说将来**真有可能**发生的事和它的结果。**if 那半句不用 will**，will 放在另一半。

examples.en: If it [[rain{s}]] tomorrow, we[['ll work]] from home.
examples.zh: 明天要是下雨，我们就在家办公。

examples.en: If you [[finish]] early, you [[can]] go home.
examples.zh: 你要是早做完，就可以回家。

examples.en: If we [[don't fix]] this, users [[will complain]].
examples.zh: 我们不修好这个，用户会投诉的。

wrong.bad: If it ~~will rain~~, we'll stay in.

second.title: 第二条件句：只是假设
second.rule: 说**现在不是真的**、或**不太可能**的事。用过去时**不是说过去**，是在说「这离现实很远」。

examples.en: If I [[had]] a car, I[['d drive]] you to the airport.
examples.zh: 我要是有车，就开车送你去机场。

examples.en: If I [[were]] you, I[['d ask]] for a pay rise.
examples.zh: 我要是你，就去要求加薪。

examples.en: If we [[didn't have]] so many meetings, we[['d finish]] faster.
examples.zh: 要是没这么多会，我们能做得更快。

notes: If I were you 是给建议的固定说法。口语里 If I was … 也常听到，但 If I were you 最好记牢。

items.en: If it rains, we [[might]] cancel the picnic.
items.zh: 要是下雨，我们可能会取消野餐。

items.rule: 叫别人做事 → 直接用动词原形
items.en: If you see Tom, [[tell]] him I'm running late.
items.zh: 你见到 Tom 就跟他说我要晚点到。

items.en: If I had a car, I [[could]] drive you.
items.zh: 我要是有车，就能送你了。

items.en: [[Unless]] you hurry, you'll miss the train.
items.zh: 你不快点就赶不上火车了。

this.meaning: 第一：真有可能拿到这份工作
this.en: If I [[get]] the job, I[['ll move]] to London.

that.en: If I [[got]] the job, I[['d move]] to London.

this.meaning: 第一：说这一次的具体结果
this.en: If you [[call]] me later, I[['ll explain]].

commonMistakes.bad: If it ~~will rain~~, we'll stay in.
If I ~~would have~~ more time, I'd travel.
commonMistakes.good: If I [[had]] more time, I'd travel.

commonMistakes.bad: If I had a car, I ~~will~~ drive you.
commonMistakes.good: If I had a car, I [[would]] drive you.
commonMistakes.why: 第二条件句的另一半用 would。

commonMistakes.bad: If I ~~am~~ you, I'd say no.
commonMistakes.good: If I [[were]] you, I'd say no.

quiz.prompt: If I ___ more time, I'd learn Japanese.
If you ___ (press) this button, the app restarts.
quiz.explain: 每次都这样：两半都用一般现在时 [[press]]。

quiz.prompt: If the tests fail, the build ___.
If it ___ (rain) tomorrow, we'll work from home.
If we don't fix this, users ___ (complain).
quiz.explain: 另一半用 [[will]] + 动词原形。

quiz.prompt: 改错：If you will finish early, you can go home.
quiz.answer: If you finish early, you can go home.
quiz.explain: if 那半句用一般现在时 [[finish]]。

quiz.prompt: If I ___ (be) you, I'd ask for a pay rise.
quiz.explain: If I [[were]] you，给建议的固定说法。

quiz.prompt: If I had a car, I ___ (drive) you to the airport.

traps.note: 假设的事，用 would，不用 will。

quiz.explain: 第二条件句另一半用 [[would]] + 原形。

quiz.prompt: 翻译：要是没这么多会，我们能做得更快。
quiz.answer: If we didn't have so many meetings, we would finish faster.
accept: If we didn't have so many meetings, we'd finish faster.
If we didn't have so many meetings, we could finish faster.
If we didn't have so many meetings, we would work faster.
If we didn't have so many meetings, we'd work faster.
If we didn't have so many meetings, we could work faster.
quiz.explain: 现在不是真的 → If + 过去时，另一半 [[would]]。

quiz.prompt: If it rains, we ___ cancel the picnic.（不太确定）
用 unless 改写：If you don't hurry, you'll miss the train.
quiz.answer: Unless you hurry, you'll miss the train.
accept: Unless you hurry, you will miss the train.
You'll miss the train unless you hurry.
You will miss the train unless you hurry.

quiz.prompt: 你觉得自己不太可能拿到这份工作：If I ___ the job, I'd move to London.
quiz.explain: 不太可能 → 第二条件句，用过去时 [[got]]。

quiz.prompt: 改错：If I would have more time, I'd travel.
quiz.answer: If I had more time, I'd travel.
accept: If I had more time, I would travel.
quiz.explain: if 那半句不用 would：If I [[had]]。

quiz.prompt: 改错：If I had a car, I will drive you.
quiz.answer: If I had a car, I would drive you.
accept: If I had a car, I'd drive you.
If I had a car, I could drive you.

quiz.prompt: 改错：If I am you, I'd say no.
quiz.answer: If I were you, I'd say no.
accept: If I were you, I would say no.
If I was you, I'd say no.

openTask.prompt: 写 3 句条件句：一句说一个总是这样的规律，一句说明天或下周真可能发生的事，一句用 If I were you 给同事一个建议。
rules: if 那半句不用 will / would
第二条件句：If + 过去时，另一半 would + 原形
openTask.note: 规则判 if 半句和主句的时态搭配（计分）；离线模型给更自然的说法（AI 建议，不计分）
